responsibility: Declares the public tree-SSA alias-analysis data structures and query API. It defines pt_solution for points-to sets and ao_ref for cached decomposed memory references, and exposes the alias oracle entry points used by optimizers to test ref/ref and stmt/ref interference, walk aliased virtual operands, query pointer/global aliasing, inspect points-to data, and invoke or consume the separate structural points-to solver implemented in tree-ssa-structalias.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the externally visible alias-analysis types and entry points, such as pt_solution, ao_ref, and the refs_may_alias_p / stmt_may_clobber_ref_p style queries, plus declarations for the separate points-to solver interface. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-alias.cc, it does not contain the alias-oracle implementation logic.
